newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Justice ministry vows to crack down on gangster influence in elections.
Doctor and girlfriend robbed, then burned nearly to death.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui, in interview with German television, says he hopes Germany will sell submarines to Taiwan.
Placido Domingo, Jose Carrera, Diana Ross to visit Taiwan.
LIBERTY TIMES - Man kills mother over T$400,000 (US$14,500).
President Lee says Taiwan will not accept China's proposed "one country, two systems" (model for national reunification).
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Industry leaders suggest state-run firms release 20-30 percent of shares through public auctions.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan stock, over-the-counter markets close higher before Chinese lunar new year holiday.
Airport cargo handlers' refusal to work overtime to affect cargo flow during Chinese lunar new year holiday.
